tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Slide and page background. Cover, section and closing slides add the two glows over it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, row cards, stat tiles, roadmap bars and upcoming step badges, always with a `line` border. Also the rules between chart legend rows.

tokens.name: surface-recessed
tokens.usage: Cards in the column that matters less (out of scope, assumptions to validate). Same `line` border.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Card borders, hairline rules between list rows, the footer rule, chart axes and the | separator.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Tag borders and the border of later roadmap phases.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, names and primary text on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-recessed` (15:1 on ground). Numerals in upcoming step badges.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy, statements, subtitles and tag text on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-recessed` (9:1 on ground, 8:1 on surface).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Section labels, dates, meta, footers and chart values. 3.6:1 on ground and 3.3:1 on surface, under the 4.5:1 floor for body text: the source deck uses it this way, so keep it to labels and meta at 24px and up on the slide, never body copy.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Excluded or deprioritized chart items and axis ticks only. 2.2:1 on ground: fails as text, so never put information a reader needs in it.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Velocity yellow. Eyebrows, the title rule, numerals, square bullets, the current phase and step, stat numbers, the classification line and chart markers. As text: 11:1 on `ground`, 10:1 on `surface`. Never body copy.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill: phase block labels, the current step numeral, chart marker numerals (11:1).

tokens.name: glow-cool
tokens.usage: Cool radial glow over `ground`, transparent at 60%. Cover: ellipse at 80% 20%. Closing: ellipse at 20% 20%.

tokens.name: glow-warm
tokens.usage: Warm radial glow (the accent at 6%) over `ground`, transparent at 60%. Cover: ellipse at 20% 80%. Closing: 80% 80%. Section slide: 50% 60%.

groups.name: Titles
groups.note: Inter Tight. Sizes are px on the 1920x1080 slide; halve them at 960 wide.

styles.name: vx-display
styles.usage: Section and closing slide titles, centered, in `ink`.

styles.name: vx-title
styles.usage: Slide titles and the cover title, in `ink`. Title Case, two lines at most.

styles.name: vx-kpi
styles.usage: The one number a stat tile is about, in `accent`.

styles.name: vx-marking
styles.usage: The classification line inside a classification callout, in `accent`.

styles.name: vx-heading
styles.usage: Names in cards and stat values, in `ink`.

styles.name: vx-lead-strong
styles.usage: Step titles, in `ink`.

styles.name: vx-lead
styles.sample: Team introductions and points of contact
styles.usage: Agenda items and key objectives in `ink`; statements, the cover subtitle and the section slide's line in `ink-secondary`.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter Tight for everything a reader reads.

styles.name: vx-body
styles.sample: Keyword filter, then two AI judges
styles.usage: Bullets, card text, row titles and milestones in `ink`; supporting lines in `ink-secondary`; the cover date line and slide subtitles in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: vx-small
styles.sample: Posted to Slack after each run
styles.usage: Second lines in compact cards and large tags (`ink-secondary`), and slide footers (`ink-muted`).

styles.name: vx-bar-title
styles.usage: Roadmap bar titles, in `ink`.

styles.name: vx-bar-text
styles.sample: Foundation must finish before the streams scale
styles.usage: Footnote text (`ink-muted`) and the title of a roadmap bar beside the current phase (`ink`).

styles.name: vx-caption
styles.usage: Tag text (`ink-secondary`) and roadmap sub-lines (`ink-muted`).

styles.name: vx-legend
styles.usage: Chart legend entries, in `ink-secondary`; `ink-faint` when the item is excluded.

styles.name: vx-fine
styles.usage: Date ranges inside roadmap phase blocks.

groups.name: Labels
groups.note: Chakra Petch, set in capitals (bundle.css adds text-transform). Tracking measured from the source deck.

styles.name: vx-eyebrow
styles.usage: The line above every slide title, in `accent`.

styles.name: vx-label
styles.usage: Section labels on a slide in `ink-muted`; role labels in cards in `accent` (ours) or `ink-secondary` (a partner's); the cover's classification marking in `ink-secondary`.

styles.name: vx-label-plain
styles.usage: Card headings in sentence case: `accent` for the lead item, `ink` for the rest.

styles.name: vx-label-sm
styles.usage: The lead-in word of a footnote, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: vx-legend-title
styles.usage: Chart legend heading, in `ink`.

styles.name: vx-axis
styles.usage: Chart axis titles, in `ink-muted`, with ↑ or → after the word.

styles.name: vx-quadrant
styles.usage: Chart quadrant names: `accent` for the two worth doing, `ink-muted` for the rest.

styles.name: vx-micro
styles.usage: Phase block labels: `on-accent` on the current phase, `accent` on the next, `ink-secondary` after. Also legend marker numerals.

styles.name: vx-micro-note
styles.usage: Quadrant sub-labels, in `ink-muted` (or `ink-faint` for the low-value pair).

groups.name: Numerals
groups.note: Chakra Petch for numbers that structure a slide.

styles.name: vx-numeral-lg
styles.usage: Agenda numbers, zero-padded, in `accent`.

styles.name: vx-numeral
styles.usage: Milestone codes, in `accent`.

styles.name: vx-numeral-badge
styles.usage: Numerals in step badges: `on-accent` on the current step, `ink` on the rest.

styles.name: vx-meta
styles.usage: Times, cadences and the agenda footer, in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: vx-marker
styles.usage: Numerals inside chart markers, in `on-accent`.

styles.name: vx-tick
styles.usage: Chart axis tick numbers, in `ink-faint`.

styles.name: vx-data
styles.usage: Values beside chart legend entries, in `ink-muted`.

spacing.note: px on the 1920x1080 slide; halve at 960 wide.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between lead-list items; a roadmap bar's title to its sub-line.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Bullet inset for lists outside cards; stat label to value; step title to its second line; title to tags in a roadmap bar.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Square bullet to its text; between tags; tag side padding; title to a slide subtitle.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between stacked cards, rows and list items in one column; label to heading inside a card; lead bullet to its text; either side of a | separator.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Phase block padding and phase block to its bar; top and bottom padding of row cards and roadmap bars; between large tags; footer rule to footer text.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Eyebrow to title; section label to its content; side padding of row cards and roadmap bars; numeral to text in a numbered list; compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-28
tokens.usage: Title to the accent rule on content slides.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Between side-by-side cards; padding of name and statement cards; step badge to its text; stat tile top and bottom padding.

tokens.name: space-36
tokens.usage: Padding of cards that hold a label and a bullet list; display title to the rule on section and closing slides.

tokens.name: space-40
tokens.usage: Stat tile side padding; bottom margin under the footer line.

tokens.name: space-48
tokens.usage: Between stat tiles.

tokens.name: space-52
tokens.usage: Accent rule to the first content row (content starts at y=310); closing logo to title.

tokens.name: space-80
tokens.usage: Between the two columns of a numbered list.

tokens.name: space-100
tokens.usage: Slide margin: left, right and top. Content is 1720px wide.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, row cards, stat tiles, phase blocks and roadmap bars.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Tags and step badges.

tokens.name: radius-marker
tokens.usage: Chart markers only, the one round shape in the system.

size.note: Fixed dimensions from the source deck, px on the 1920x1080 slide.

tokens.name: slide-width
tokens.usage: Slide canvas width.

tokens.name: slide-height
tokens.usage: Slide canvas height.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every card border and hairline rule (1px at 960).

tokens.name: rule-width
tokens.usage: Accent rule under a content slide title.

tokens.name: rule-weight
tokens.usage: Thickness of the content slide and closing slide accent rule.

tokens.name: rule-width-hero
tokens.usage: Accent rule on cover, section and closing slides.

tokens.name: rule-weight-hero
tokens.usage: Thickness of the cover and section slide accent rule.

tokens.name: bullet
tokens.usage: Square bullet in body (28px) lists.

tokens.name: bullet-lead
tokens.usage: Square bullet in lead (34px) lists.

tokens.name: badge
tokens.usage: Step badge, square.

tokens.name: tag-height
tokens.usage: Tag outer height (18px text).

tokens.name: tag-height-lg
tokens.usage: Large tag outer height (24px text), for channels and tools.

tokens.name: marker
tokens.usage: Chart marker diameter.

tokens.name: marker-legend
tokens.usage: Legend marker diameter.

tokens.name: phase-block
tokens.usage: Width of a roadmap phase block.

tokens.name: numeral-column
tokens.usage: Width of the code column in a milestone list.

tokens.name: list-width
tokens.usage: Width of a step list; its rules stop short of the right margin.

tokens.name: chart-height
tokens.usage: Plot height when a chart fills the slide under its header.

tokens.name: legend-width
tokens.usage: Width of a chart legend beside its plot.

tokens.name: logo-height
tokens.usage: Logo lockup on the cover, top left.

tokens.name: logo-height-closing
tokens.usage: Logo lockup on the closing slide, centered above the title.
